About This Auction

HYBRID AUCTION- ONLINE AND LIVE PROPERTY: 812 +/- acres split into 10 tracts surrounding Mound Valley, KS, tillable, pasture, recreational and build sites AUCTION DATE: November 4, 2025. 6:00pm CST, Online bidding starts November 1, 2025 at 10:00AM LOCATION: Cherryvale Community Center, 712 S. Liberty St, Cherryvale, KS 67335 After five generations of family ownership, this expansive 812+/- acre property situated surrounding Mound Valley, KS,  is being made available for the first time. Divided into 10 tracts, this land offers a wide variety of options for buyers, whether you’re looking for tillable farmland, pastureland for grazing, or a potential home site. With tracts ranging from 7.78 +/- acres to 160+/- acres, there’s something for everyone at this auction. The property includes: Tillable Land: Fertile, productive acreage ideal for farming or crop production. The current non-tillable tracts also have potential to be turned to tillable! Pastureland: Open spaces perfect for livestock or recreational use. Recreational Land: A variety of landscapes offering room for hunting or other outdoor activities. Tract 1 – 7.78± Acres Don’t let the size fool you—this small but beautiful tract along Hwy 160 and Gray Rd packs in plenty of character. The west end features dense, mature timber offering shade and seclusion, while the east side opens up to a scenic hay meadow. A unique spot with lots of potential! Tract 2 – 59.4± Acres Located just north of Hwy 160 and east of Gray Rd, this pasture tract includes two ponds and wide open spaces. The northwest corner offers a ready-made area for hay storage or a potential homesite. With easy access and open space, it's ideal for livestock, hobby farming, or building your dream home. Tract 3 – 36.12± Acres Situated north of Mound Valley on 15000 Rd, this tract is currently a productive hay meadow but offers flexibility for future tillable use. Mature timber runs through the center, creating excellent cover for wildlife and great recreational potential. A perfect blend of agriculture and outdoor enjoyment. Tract 4 – 160± Acres A true gem in the countryside—this tillable tract lies south of Mound Valley along Gray Rd and 13000 Rd. Pumpkin Creek winds through the property, dividing it into three fields with mature timber lining the banks. The mix of quality cropland, timber, and water provides strong farming potential and recreational oppurtunity. Tract 5 – 147.6± Acres Located along Hwy 160 and Ford Rd just west of Mound Valley, this highly desirable tract is nearly all tillable and well-positioned for continued crop production. Whether you’re expanding your operation or seeking a solid land investment, this one checks all the boxes. Tract 6 – ~60± Acres (Pending Survey) This productive tillable tract lies north of Mound Valley at the corner of 13th St and Gove Rd. It’s the southern section of a larger parcel (with Tract 7) and will be surveyed to determine boundary. Great soil quality and access make it a solid addition to any farming portfolio. Tract 7 – ~80± Acres (Pending Survey) The northern portion of a larger parcel, this fenced and cross-fenced pasture features two ponds—one on each side of the dividing fence. Ideal for rotational grazing or livestock operations, this tract combines functionality and natural beauty. Survey to be completed with Tract 6 to determine boundary. Tract 8 – 90.32± Acres (14038 Gray Rd) This diverse tract offers fenced pasture, a pond, cross fencing, and several outbuildings for storage. The old farmhouse has not been inhabited for many years but remains on site. Utilities are available, making this an excellent site for a new home, ranch setup, or weekend retreat. Tract 9 – 85.35± Acres With Hwy 160 access, cross fencing, and a pond, this tract is currently being used as pasture but has strong potential to be converted to tillable acreage. The land is well-suited for multiple uses—ranching, farming, or recreation—all in a great location. Tract 10 – 75.57± Acres Located east of Mound Valley on 14500 Rd, this versatile tract includes fenced pasture, a hay field in the southeast corner with Hwy 160 access, mature timber, a small creek, and a pond. Surrounded by tillable land, it’s a prime candidate for hunting, grazing, or development into a hobby farm or recreational property. Mark your calendars now for November 4th and don't miss out on this exceptional opportunity!  Call or text today for additional information or schedule your showing, Amanda Lauber 620-212-9013.
